05 ·  FAQ

Questions, answered.

Vertex is one platform with two tools inside it. Synthex is where you create and sell digital products — courses, ebooks, templates. Sendbox is where you build your email list and send broadcasts, sequences and automations. They share one dashboard, one audience and one subscription.

No. Inside Vertex they are a single product. A buyer in Synthex automatically becomes a subscriber in Sendbox, and a Sendbox email can link straight to a Synthex checkout — nothing to connect or sync yourself.

Yes — Sendbox includes signup forms and lead-magnet delivery, so your product pages grow your list from day one. Every free download and every sale adds to the same audience.

Checkout is built into every product page. Connect your payment account once, share your link, and Vertex handles the checkout, delivery and receipts. Pro plans pay 0% platform fee on top of the payment provider's own fee.

Yes. The Starter plan is free — one product, up to 500 subscribers, payments included, no credit card required. Upgrade only when your list or catalogue outgrows it.
